name: Selection
description: Represents the selection in the specified document window. The Selection object is deleted whenever you change slides in an active slide view (the Type property will return ppSelectionNone).

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Represents the type of objects in a selection. Read-only.

properties.name: SlideRange
properties.description: Returns a SlideRange object that represents a range of selected slides. Read-only.

properties.name: ShapeRange
properties.description: Returns a ShapeRange object that represents all the slide objects that have been selected on the specified slide. Read-only.

properties.name: TextRange
properties.description: Returns a TextRange object that represents the selected text. Read-only.

properties.name: ChildShapeRange
properties.description: Returns a ShapeRange object that represents the child shapes of a selection.

properties.name: HasChildShapeRange
properties.description: True if the selection contains child shapes. Read-only.

properties.name: TextRange2
properties.description: Returns the TextRange2 object of the current Selection object. Read-only.

methods.name: Cut
methods.description: Deletes the specified object and places it on the Clipboard.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies the specified object to the Clipboard.
